verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own product docs confirm DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation, Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, DLAA, and Reflex are supported on the RTX 5070 Ti, with the NVIDIA app enabling updates across hundreds of games. Independent hands-on review corroborates the card's real-world performance/cooling but doesn't specifically detail game-by-game DLSS compatibility lists. Missing for 10: an independent third-party benchmark specifically validating DLSS/frame-gen behavior across a broad game list beyond vendor claims.
